say:3:1621718003:1.text: So, the three of you are in the preparatory class? Seeing you really brings back memories.
say:3:1621718003:1.source_cn: 所以，你们三个都是莱希拉姆的预科生？哈，真令人怀念啊。

say:4:1621718004:1.text: What's so great about it? It's all classes, homework, and endless revisions… and the exams are a nightmare!
say:4:1621718004:1.source_cn: 预科班有什么好怀念的，每天都要上一大堆课，要写作业、背...

say:5:1621718005:1.text: That's just you, Roonil. I actually enjoy the exams.
say:5:1621718005:1.source_cn: 只有你害怕，雷蒙德。我觉得那些考试还挺有意思的。

say:6:1621718006:1.text: Anyway, I find it terribly dull. Girod, do we get fewer classes and less homework once we're seniors?
say:6:1621718006:1.source_cn: 反正就是很无聊！吉罗德，升到高年级之后，是不是就不用每...

say:7:1621718007:1.text: I'm afraid not. Everything's largely the same, but the courses are harder, and the material is more advanced.
say:7:1621718007:1.source_cn: 当然不是，高年级只是课程变难、学习的魔法层次变深，其余...

say:8:1621718008:1.text: What? That sounds bleak... Maybe I should just stay in the preparatory class...
say:8:1621718008:1.source_cn: 什么，听上去日子更难过了……那我不要升到高年级了……

say:9:1621718009:1.text: Honestly, that's not for you to decide.
say:9:1621718009:1.source_cn: 恕我直言，这可由不得你。

say:10:1621718010:1.text: Haha... being seniors has plenty of perks too! You'll gain more hands-on experience and take part in all kinds of fun activities.
say:10:1621718010:1.source_cn: 哈哈……别这么担心啊，高年级也有不少好处的。升到高年级...

say:11:1621718011:1.text: You can go to balls, participate in magic tournaments, and join a wide variety of clubs.
say:11:1621718011:1.source_cn: 比如热闹的节日舞会、刺激的魔法竞技赛……还有种类丰富的...

say:12:1621718012:1.text: As for me, I love singing, and I've met lots of like-minded friends in my club. We're even planning to form a band!
